name: Scree-Ghoul

abilities.name: Entomb (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: The scree-ghoul entombs one Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. While entombed, the target is blinded and restrained, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the scree-ghoul, and takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the scree-ghoul's turns. The scree-ghoul can have only one creature entombed at a time. If the scree-ghoul takes 15 damage or more in a single turn from the entombed creature, the scree-ghoul must release the target at the end of that turn, and the target exits prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the scree-ghoul. If the scree-ghoul dies, an entombed creature breaks free prone by using 5 feet of movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scree-ghoul makes two Grinding Grip attacks.

actions.name: Grinding Grip
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled, the target is restrained.

actions.name: Scree-Surge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 20-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 24 (7d6) bludgeoning damage and be pulled up to 20 feet straight toward the scree-ghoul and be knocked prone.

other_edition.lore: Settled from generations of wasted rubble at the bottom of an abandoned quarry, the scree-ghoul is the pit's hunger given motion, wanting nothing more than to pull warm things down beneath the stones and keep them there.
